title: ALMA observations of molecular absorption in four directions toward the Galactic bulge
question: Can diffuse molecular gas in the Galactic bulge be detected in absorption toward other mm-wave continuum sources, and how do its chemistry, kinematics and 12C/13C compare with disk and CMZ gas?

what.value: HI absorption profiles toward J1717 and J1744

evidence.quote: we use the H I absorption profiles of Dickey et al. (1983)

what.value: Local-cloud CS, HCN, HCO+ and C2H absorption measurements for comparison

evidence.quote: We also use the CS and HCN absorption profiles for local clouds from Lucas & Liszt (2002) and Liszt & Lucas (2001), respectively

external_data.citation: Lucas & Liszt (2002); Liszt & Lucas (2001); Lucas & Liszt (2000)

what.value: K-band extinction A_K from 3-D bulge extinction map

evidence.quote: the 3-D IR extinction map of the Galactic bulge of Schultheis et al. (2014)

recipe.method: Spectra taken at peak continuum pixel from continuum-subtracted cubes and divided by continuum

recipe.goal: Derive HCO+ and H13CO+ column densities and isotopic ratios
recipe.method: Integrate optical depths in limit of no excitation above CMB; Monte Carlo for errors

recipe.goal: Derive H2 and HI column densities and molecular fractions
recipe.method: N(H2)=N(HCO+)/3e-9; optical-depth-corrected N(HI) from Eq. 1 with Dickey HI absorption

recipe.goal: Gaussian decomposition of HCN, CS and HI profiles
recipe.method: Gaussian components fit to line profiles; CS fit subtracted to integrate remainder over HCN components

recipe.goal: Limit HI spin temperature of self-absorbing gas
recipe.method: Solve two radiative transfer equations for foreground/background spin temperatures using HI absorption and emission

evidence.loc: 5.1 Absorption arising inside the Galactic disk
evidence.quote: N(HCO + )/N(H 13 CO + ) > 51 (3σ) for the bulge gas toward J1744

answer_key.quantity: HI self-absorbing component optical depth toward J1744

evidence.quote: τ fg = 0.686 ± 0.081 corresponding to T sp, fg = 16.2(+8.0, −10.2) K

answer_key.quantity: Spin temperature of foreground self-absorbing HI

evidence.loc: 4.3 Inner-Galaxy gas along the line of sight to J1717
4.4 The far-side 3 kpc arm toward J1744
evidence.quote: 2N(H 2 ) = 7.3 ± 1.2 × 10 19 cm −2, ie, the gas is ≈ 48% molecular.

score_reason: Simple pipeline-product spectra and clear formulae, but observation setup and fitting details are thin.
